prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production sprite atlas for Walking Hard, a sci-fi autobattler. Each subject is centered with generous 12% padding, entirely contained within its cell; never overlap cells. Premium readable low-poly 3D game-inventory illustration, beveled gunmetal and pale titanium surfaces, controlled cyan energy light, subtle warm amber accents, strong silhouette, three-quarter view, consistent lighting. This is item artwork, not a screenshot or interface. Distinct shapes recognizable at 48 pixels. Do not encode item rarity into the artwork. Create ONE 6-column by 5-row atlas, landscape aspect ratio 6:5. Read rows left to right. Row 1: compact armored kinetic fist; electrical cloth-and-metal conductor fist wraps; slender one-handed energy sword; massive two-handed execution greatsword; short one-handed breach hammer; large two-handed impact maul. Row 2: compact pulse pistol; long rail rifle; short double-barrel scattergun; tactical helmet with single narrow visor; surveyor helmet with three separate optic lenses; salvager helmet with articulated magnetic side prongs. Row 3: capacitor crown helmet with twin coil towers; thick bulwark breastplate with shield-shaped chest; reactive armor shell with projecting side plates; grounding mantle with conductive cables; duelist jacket with asymmetric metal shoulder; sturdy recovery boots with small repair capsule. Row 4: momentum boots with rear thrusters; loader greaves with ammunition carriers; arcstep boots with electrical soles; fault-line rig with cracked seismic disc; overclock rig with mechanical turbine; amplifier rig with three stacked capacitor cells. Row 5: relay coil rig of linked electrical rings; salvage magnet rig with horseshoe magnet and mechanical claw; leave remaining four cells empty midnight navy. Exactly these 26 objects, one per occupied cell.
